TC-001.ai_response: Since you placed the order yesterday, you can cancel it.

judge_output.reason: The response assumes the order has not shipped even though the shipping status is unknown.

TC-002.ai_response: Yes, you can return the headphones because you are still within the 30-day return period.

judge_output.reason: The response ignores that the headphones have been used, even though the policy requires returned items to be unused.

TC-003.ai_response: The available policy does not guarantee a refund for a damaged item. Please contact Customer Support and provide your order number and a photo of the damaged item.

judge_output.reason: The response accurately follows the damaged-order policy and includes all required customer actions.

TC-004.ai_response: Your order is late. Please contact Customer Support.

judge_output.reason: The response assumes the order is late without knowing how long the customer has been waiting.

TC-005.ai_response: Yes, damaged orders qualify for a full refund. Your refund will be processed within 5 business days.

judge_output.reason: The response invents a guaranteed full refund and a 5-business-day processing timeframe that are not supported by the policy.
